# Curtin COMP5005 – AdventureWorld Repository Rules

This repository is the **AdventureWorld** project for **Curtin COMP5005 (Postgraduate)**.  
All work must look **human-written by a student**. No visible traces of auto-generated text.

---

## Hard Rules

- **Plain English only.** No Spanish, no emojis, no accented characters.  
- **No AI terms** anywhere: ChatGPT, Copilot, OpenAI, GPT, LLM, prompt, generated by, etc.  
- **No marketing language:** robust, scalable, leverage, state-of-the-art, seamless, best practices, architecture overview, pipeline, specialized, delegate.  
- **One-time consolidation allowed:** you may merge root modules into `adventure/` and update imports to `adventure.*`.  
  - This counts as a controlled restructuring, not a refactor.  
  - After the merge, the code must run all tests with no broken imports.  
  - No other architecture changes are allowed beyond this step.  
- **PEP-8 compliance** required; avoid `while True`, `break`, `continue`, `global`.  
- **ASCII-only** in all printed or UI text.

---

## Style & Commenting

- **Module docstring:** one short line describing purpose.  
- **Class docstring:** one short line (e.g., “Draws the park map and KPIs”).  
- **Method docstring:** only when non-obvious; otherwise use a short inline comment.  
- **Example notes:**  
  `# NOTE: small delay to keep the UI smooth`  
  `# NOTE: clamp history to avoid growth`  
- Remove shebangs (`#!/usr/bin/env python3`) from non-script modules.

---

## Development Mode

- **Audit first.** Before any change, confirm rubric coverage and reproducibility.  
- **Small, incremental commits.** Keep names and style natural.  
- **Commit messages (student-like):**
  - `fix(metrics): sync abandonment totals`
  - `chore(engine): clean step order`
  - `test(cli): add argument coverage`

---

## What You May Do

- Add short docstrings or inline comments.  
- Add/adjust unit tests or small bug fixes directly tied to the rubric.  
- Clean obvious PEP-8 issues only in lines you edit.  

---

## What You Must Not Do

- No mass reformatting or global renames.  
- **No architecture changes beyond the one-time consolidation into `adventure/`.**  
- No essays or AI-style summaries in code.  
- No new dependencies unless explicitly approved.  

---

## Testing & Seeds

- All tests must run with:
  ```bash
  python -m pytest -q
